versions.text: The powerplant cooling provisions must be able to maintain the temperatures of powerplant components and fluids within the limits established during ground and flight operation.

[The powerplant cooling provisions must be able to maintain the temperatures of powerplant components and engine fluids, within the temperature limit established during ground and flight operation to the maximum altitude for which approval is requested.]

[The powerplant and auxiliary power unit cooling provisions must maintain the temperatures of powerplant components and engine fluids, and auxiliary power unit components and fluids within the limits established for those components and fluids under the most adverse ground, water, and flight operations to the maximum altitude for which approval is requested, and after normal engine and auxiliary power unit shutdown.]

The powerplant and auxiliary power unit cooling provisions must maintain the temperatures of powerplant components and engine fluids, and auxiliary power unit components and fluids within the limits established for those components and fluids under the most adverse ground, water, and flight operations to the maximum altitude [and maximum ambient atmospheric temperature conditions for which approval is requested, and after normal engine and auxiliary power unit shutdown.]
